description: U+FEFF residual F: content against length. Rows after a leading U+FEFF: 3, 20 and 100 U+00E9; 3, 20 and 100 euro; x euro x; 99 x then euro; euro then 99 x; a non-leading U+FEFF then 100 x; two leading U+FEFF then 100 x; U+FEFF U+FFFE then 100 x; a plain 100 x control. Asks whether the trigger depends on length, on the characters after the U+FEFF, or on the first non-Latin-1 unit. Rows: ID 1 e3, ID 2 e20, ID 3 e100, ID 4 eur3, ID 5 eur20, ID 6 eur100, ID 7 x-eur-x2, ID 8 x99-eur, ID 9 eur-x99, ID 10 ab-lead-x100, ID 11 lead2-x100, ID 12 lead-fffe-x100, ID 13 x100-plain.
